title: Efficient LLM Collaboration via Planning
abstract: arXiv:2506.11578v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance, ranging from simple to complex tasks. However, while large models achieve remarkable results across diverse tasks, they often incur substantial monetary inference cost, making frequent use impractical for many applications. In contrast, small models are often freely available and easy to deploy locally, but their performance on complex tasks remains limited. This trade-off raises a natural question: how can small and large models efficiently collaborate to combine their complementary strengths? To bridge this trade-off, we propose COPE, a test-time collaboration framework. A planner model first generates a plan that serves as a lightweight intermediate that guides a downstream executor model. translated_title: 通过规划实现高效的大语言模型协作
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.11578v5 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期，大型语言模型（LLMs）在从简单到复杂的各类任务中展现了强大的性能。然而，尽管大型模型在多种任务上取得了显著成果，它们通常会产生高昂的货币推理成本，这使得在许多应用中频繁使用变得不切实际。相比之下，小型模型通常免费可用且易于本地部署，但它们在复杂任务上的性能仍然有限。这种权衡引发了一个自然的问题：小型和大型模型如何高效协作，以结合它们的互补优势？为了弥合这一权衡，我们提出了COPE，一个测试时协作框架。一个规划器模型首先生成一个计划，作为指导下游执行器模型的轻量级中间产物。小型和大型模型轮流担任规划器和执行器，在多阶段级联中交换计划，以协作解决任务。通过全面的实验...
tldr: 本文提出COPE框架，通过让小型和大型模型在测试时轮流担任规划器和执行器并交换计划，实现高效协作，以结合两者的互补优势并降低推理成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the COPE framework, which enables efficient collaboration between small and large models by having them alternately serve as planner and executor and exchange plans at test time, combining their complementary strengths while reducing inference costs.
